# copick add tiltseries

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Add a tilt series from a stack and its acquisition metadata.*

## Usage

```bash
copick add tiltseries [OPTIONS] PATH
```

## Description

Imports an MRC, TIFF or Zarr stack as a multiscale tilt series, with the nominal tilt angles, acquisition order,
dose, movies and CTF fits found in a SerialEM mdoc (next to the stack by default), an angle file and a CTF file.
A glob pattern imports many stacks; the run name is then taken from each file name.

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `PATH` | The stack (.mrc, .st, .mrcs, .ali, .tif, .zarr) or a glob pattern. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--run-name-prefix` | text | `""` | Prefix to prepend to run names after regex extraction. |
| `--run-regex` | text | `(.*)` | Regular expression to extract the run name from the filename. If not provided, will use the file name without extension. The regex should capture the run name in the first group. |
| `--run` | text | `""` | The name of the run. If not specified, will use the name of the file (stripping extension), ignored if PATH is glob pattern. |
| `--ts-type` | text | `raw` | Type of the tilt series. |
| `--file-type` | choice (mrc \| tiff \| zarr) | — | Format of the stack. Default: from the extension (.mrc, .st, .mrcs, .ali, .tif, .tiff, .zarr). |
| `--pixel-size` | float | — | Pixel size in Angstrom, overriding the stack's header. |
| `--angles` | file | — | Tilt angles in stack order: IMOD .rawtlt/.tlt or AreTomo3 _TLT.txt. |
| `--angles-format` | choice (rawtlt \| tlt \| aretomo3-tlt) | — | Format of --angles. Default: from its name. |
| `--mdoc` | text | `auto` | SerialEM mdoc: a path, 'auto' (the stack's sibling <stack>.mdoc or <stem>.mdoc) or 'none'. |
| `--ctf` | file | — | Per-image CTF fits: AreTomo3 _CTF.txt, CTFFIND4 output, Warp XML or RELION tomograms.star. |
| `--ctf-format` | choice (aretomo3 \| ctffind4 \| warp \| relion) | — | Format of --ctf. Default: from its name. |
| `--dose-per-tilt` | float | — | Dose of every image in e/Å², overriding the mdoc. |
| `--voltage` | float | — | Acceleration voltage in kV. |
| `--cs` | float | — | Spherical aberration in mm. |
| `--amplitude-contrast` | float | — | Amplitude contrast (e.g. 0.07). |
| `--tilt-axis` | float | — | Tilt-axis angle in degrees, overriding the mdoc. |
| `--handedness` | choice (right_handed \| left_handed) | — | Handedness of the acquisition geometry, if known. |
| `--section-map` | choice (auto \| index \| sorted \| angle) | `auto` | How the rows of a file map to tilt-series sections: 'auto' (the file's default), 'index' (row i is section i), 'sorted' (rows in ascending angle pair with sections in ascending nominal angle) or 'angle' (nearest nominal angle). |
| `--angle-tolerance` | float | `1.0` | Largest difference in degrees between a row's angle and the nominal angle of its section. |
| `--sort-by-angle / --keep-order` | boolean flag | `False` | Store the sections in ascending nominal tilt angle, or in the stack's order. |
| `--is-aligned` | boolean flag | `False` | The images are already aligned. |
| `--pyramid-levels` | integer | `3` | Number of pyramid levels. |
| `--chunk-size` | text | `1,1024,1024` | Chunk shape 'z,y,x'. |
| `--dtype` | choice (float32 \| float16 \| int16 \| uint16 \| int8 \| uint8 \| keep) | `float32` | Data type of the stored images ('keep': that of the stack). |
| `--max-workers` | integer | `4` | Maximum number of worker threads. |
| `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` | boolean flag | `False` | Overwrite the object if it exists. |
| `--create / --no-create` | boolean flag | `True` | Create the object if it does not exist. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
# A SerialEM stack with its mdoc (TS_01.mrc.mdoc) next to it
copick add tiltseries TS_01.mrc -c config.json --voltage 300 --cs 2.7

# An AreTomo3 output stack with its angle and CTF files
copick add tiltseries TS_01.mrc --angles TS_01_TLT.txt --ctf TS_01_CTF.txt -c config.json

# Many stacks, run names from the file names
copick add tiltseries "stacks/TS_*.st" -c config.json --run-regex "^(TS_\d+)"
```
